method: ENTIRELY from AMH across three pages, read under subscription and PARAPHRASED: no passage reproduced, no source_text stored, and NOTHING here is machine re-checkable. A targeted search of RACGP's open AJGP for bipolar disorder and for lithium monitoring returned NO RESULTS AT ALL; that absence is recorded rather than filled. AMH's own first paragraph limits its guidance to BIPOLAR I, and that limit is carried into the guideline's scope rather than quietly generalised.
